# External call-bell audio

## `call_bell_cc0.wav`

- Source: OpenGameArt, “Bell dings/chimes”
- Author: PWL
- URL: https://opengameart.org/content/bell-dingschimes
- License: CC0 / public domain
- Original file: `bell_ding1.wav`
- Modification: renamed only

## `call_intercom_noise.wav`

- Source: derived from the project's existing `background_whitenoise_talk.mp3`
- Modification: 0.9-second excerpt, high-pass/low-pass filtering and short fades
- Purpose: temporary indistinct intercom noise without recognizable speech

The intercom cue can later be replaced by the shortlisted Pixabay “intercom in”
sound under the Pixabay Content License:
https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/film-special-effects-intercom-in-83962/
